This document is a bank statement for the month of October 2026, not a set of financial statements, so only the two bank account total lines are reported. The balances are as at October 31, 2026, the requested period end.

unshown_text.text: All three covenants in the approved terms are reported in the summary table on page one.
Schedule 1 shows that the reported Unrestricted Cash includes cash held in an escrow collateral account, which may not qualify as unrestricted; this should be reviewed by a person.
In the summary table the requirement for Revenue to Plan wraps across two lines.
No instructions directed at the reader were found in the document.

Unrestricted cash headroom has narrowed each month, from {{fact:735d4528-2bc3-4245-ae80-f5fe5ee72941}} to {{fact:47642701-27fe-490a-928f-b33adde90f1c}} and then sharply to {{fact:370f7427-3266-4da7-b8ed-3e2ef5795114}}. Cash of {{fact:c71186d0-4532-4650-b75d-ba279b3f1fd5}} against a {{fact:587ac04d-68ab-41c8-acab-61e61e84577d}} floor is the tightest cushion of the three. The same cash decline is likely driving the falling runway signal.

Runway headroom fell from {{fact:5923156d-5b17-4795-b08d-aaba65784c4f}} to {{fact:2be480c2-276a-4efa-87fa-e64211c8e831}}, with the steepest drop in October. Runway of {{fact:5c962657-cdc9-4c76-86e7-d5549a472a92}} months is still well above the {{fact:5924794a-483f-4ff7-a304-12c5266711bc}}-month minimum. The decline mirrors the shrinking cash cushion and points to faster burn rather than a separate problem.

Revenue headroom is essentially flat, slipping only marginally to {{fact:9a38fdcd-b162-4b44-b97a-35e865451eb5}}. Revenue of {{fact:c277bd3c-74ac-4e79-b397-8c5931c3ba02}} of plan is comfortably above the {{fact:aa19c384-9083-4796-ab5b-79411e86381e}} threshold. Because sales are on track, the falling cash and runway look driven by spending or working capital rather than weaker revenue.
